usage: llm-modelbench campaign [-h]
                               {init,execute,supersede,status,resume,package,clean,migrate-legacy,plan,run} ...

Manage isolated campaign workspaces. Config execution is strict and records an
immutable plan signature; supersession appends validated evidence and never
rewrites primary rows.

positional arguments:
  {init,execute,supersede,status,resume,package,clean,migrate-legacy,plan,run}
    init                write a declarative campaign JSON template
    execute             execute strict campaign config with immutable plan
                        signature
    supersede           append immutable corrected-evidence supersession
    status              show campaign lifecycle state
    resume              resume the exact recorded interrupted campaign phase
    package             write one campaign review package
    clean               preview or apply conservative retained-evidence
                        cleanup
    migrate-legacy      copy a legacy run into a campaign
    plan                create an isolated campaign plan
    run                 run a primary benchmark inside a campaign

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
